title: BrowserAutomationReceipt v1
description: Governs every automation transport started in BearBrowser. A receipt must exist before any automation session runs and must be updated on revocation or termination.

sessionRef.description: Reference to the active BearBrowser session.

ownerRef.description: Reference to the agent, plugin, or workspace that owns this session.

permissionScope.description: Explicit set of permissions granted for this session.

origin.description: Where the automation session originates from.

userVisible.description: The session must be visible to the user at all times.

revocable.description: The session must be revocable by the user.

policyDecisionRef.description: Reference to the PolicyFabric decision that admitted this session.

evidenceRefs.description: References to provenance evidence artifacts supporting this receipt.

capturedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the receipt was first created.

status.description: Terminal or non-terminal state of the automation session.

revokedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the session was revoked. Present only when status is revoked.

tabScope.description: Tab/window/page identifiers controlled by this session.

displayName.description: Human-readable label for the owning agent/plugin/workspace shown in the session UI.
